PAPER MOONS

by Lena Ortiz

FADE IN:

INT. PRINT SHOP - DAY

Stacks of paper tower toward the ceiling. A press thunders. JUNO
(20s) feeds sheets into the machine with practiced, bored speed.

JUNO
You're late again.

OSCAR
(shrugging)
The bus was later.

JUNO
Then take an earlier bus. Or walk. Or fly.

EXT. ALLEY - NIGHT

Rain. Oscar smokes under a rusted fire escape.

OSCAR: I could quit tomorrow, you know.
JUNO: You say that every single night.

SMASH CUT TO:

INT. PRINT SHOP - CONTINUOUS

The press jams with a horrible SCREECH. Paper everywhere.

THE END
